items.label: la tête
items.scene: A robot's HEAD built of bright TETRIS ("TEHT") blocks clicks neatly into place on its neck, one last block dropping in.

items.label: l'oreille
items.scene: A friendly stingray RAY ("oh-REHY") watches from its glass tank beside a baby elephant fanning out one huge floppy EAR.

items.label: la langue
items.scene: A frog on the ENT chair stretches out a LONG, LONG ("LAHNG") TONGUE to hold a pink seashell up to the smiling baby elephant.

items.label: la bouche
items.scene: A potted BUSH ("BOOSH") is clipped into a giant smiling MOUTH, lips and two rows of leafy teeth, saying aah.

items.label: la lèvre
items.scene: A girl pulls a big wooden LEVER ("LEHVR") on a puppet stand, and the puppet's red LIPS lift into a huge smile.

items.label: le nez
items.scene: A pony NEIGHS ("NAY") so hard through its big NOSE that the doctor's paper hat blows off.

items.label: le cou
items.scene: A wooden CUCKOO ("KOO") springs out of its clock on an extra-long stretchy NECK and coos at the patients.

items.label: le front
items.scene: A boy FROWNS ("FROHN") so hard that his whole FOREHEAD wrinkles, and a ladybird slides down the creases.
